title: Chapter 10
text:
Team A retraced their steps and met up with Team D at the entrance.

"Team B might have been wiped out. I'm going to call for backup. Guard the entrance."

Team A's leader looked at the people present.

There were a total of thirty-one guards, thirty-one guns aimed at the corridor. As long as Zero appeared, they would instantly tear him to pieces with a metal storm!

Suddenly, Team A's leader felt that something was wrong … Wait, aren't we supposed to have thirty people?

Beep! Beep!

The door lit up with a green light, and the entrance opened abruptly.

Everyone turned around and saw an agent in black with a tactical backpack standing beside the entrance. He was holding a white card. His fingers pushed up the brim of his cap as he turned around and whistled happily at everyone.

"Bye bye."

The man pulled down the door lock and rolled on the ground, jumping out of the room before the door was locked.

All the guards were petrified. They stood rooted to the ground, dumbfounded.

Veins popped out on Team A's leader's forehead. The locked door seemed to be mocking him silently.

"When did Zero sneak in?"

…

The eighty-centimeter-thick alloy door slammed shut.

Finally, he escaped!

The long-awaited sunlight shone on his body. It was warm and comfortable, and the stuffy feeling in his chest slowly dissipated. He looked at the sky. It was about four or five in the afternoon. The star that radiated light and heat hung high in the sky. In the picture of white clouds and blue sky, he could vaguely see the outlines of several planets. Some were near, some were far. He could even see the crater of the nearest one. These planets were the source of the Blue Star's moonlight, refracting the star's light at night.

Han Xiaoxin took a deep breath. The fresh air filled his nostrils. The smell of freedom made him feel relaxed.

From the beginning to the end, Han Xiao did not plan to fight with all the guards. Even if the base's defense was at its weakest, whether he could win or not was secondary. If the number of guards was too high and they lost all hope, the sentinel guarding the entrance would immediately activate the door lock.

Even if he turned into Rambo and killed all the guards in First Blood, the moment the door was locked, the escape plan would be over. By then, it would be Han Xiao's turn to be stunned.

After he pretended to be a member of Team B to lure Team A out, he took a clean uniform from the corpses on the ground, took off the Lightweight Mechanical Arm, and put it in his tactical backpack. He hid in the corner between the second and third floor. It was a blind spot, and if one did not look carefully, it would be hard to notice him.

Having stayed in a safe environment for too long, the guards' alertness was very low. Han Xiao was well aware of this. Team A's attention was all on providing support. After hurriedly turning the corner, Han Xiao quietly followed behind Team A. He kept a low profile and pressed the brim of his cap very low.

This group of Team A guards obviously did not expect Han Xiao to be so daring. Who would count their teammates for no reason? For a moment, no one noticed that there was an additional person at the back of the group.

Therefore, Han Xiao followed Team A to the entrance safely. When the guards were distracted, he quietly approached the entrance and locked all the guards in the base.

This was a risky move. If anything went wrong, he would be shot to death by dozens of guns at close range. If he had a choice, he would not have taken such a risk. Unfortunately, his original plan had been foiled by Baltar, so he had no choice but to take the risk. He was willing to give it a shot with a success rate of about fifty percent.

Surrounded by abandoned farms, Han Xiao found the tracks left by the SUVs. Following the tracks, he found the garage. A few black bulletproof SUVs were lying quietly in the garage. The keys were hanging by the garage door for easy access. Of course, it was convenient for him now.

Reinforcements might appear at any time. I can't stay here for long.

Escaping from the lab was only the first step. The Germinal Organization would definitely come after him.

He threw the backpack with the mechanical arm on the passenger seat, took the keys, and started the car. He touched the steering wheel. Oh, it's made of real leather.

He stepped on the accelerator, and the high-horsepower engine roared. The off-road vehicle broke through the fence like a wild dog and rushed into the forest.

Han Xiao was completely clueless about the surrounding terrain, so he could only identify one direction.

…

On the Black Harrier helicopter, Hella's phone rang. She frowned and picked it up. "Who is it?"

"Manager Hella, something happened at the base. Zero lost control and killed more than thirty guards, deputy manager Baltar, and Professor Lin Wei Xian. He destroyed the lab data …"

The leader of Team A sounded depressed. They would have to take the blame for their failure. If they did not inform the manager, not only would their future be in danger, but their lives would be in danger as well. Not to mention, they were still locked up in the base. If no one came to open the door, would they have to stare at each other until the end of time?

Hila was shocked. Are you playing a prank on me? She had personally brainwashed Zero. Was Zero faking it at that time? There was no problem with the brainwashing effect of the other test subjects.

Had she been deceived from the beginning?

Hella hurriedly contacted the leader and repeated what the leader of Team A had said. The leader's breathing became heavy, as if he was suppressing his anger.

"Turn around immediately and chase after him."

Hella was reluctant. "My sister …"

"Shut up. You have no right to bargain with me."

Hella bit her lip and shouted at the pilot, "Turn around and return to the base!"

"Executive Hella, the plane needs to land and refuel."

"Hurry up."

…

The Owl Squad received their leader's order halfway. A few off-road vehicles turned around and opened the gate of the base from the outside. The agents who had been locked inside walked out with their faces covered in dirt.

Looking at the pitiful state of the base, Number One's face was filled with shock and anger, his expression mixed with disbelief. He pointed at the leader of Team A and said angrily, "There are dozens of you and you can't even stop one person. Is there a traitor?!"

He did not believe that he could do it, but he also did not believe that Han Xiao could do it.

The faces of the guards changed drastically. No one could bear the accusation of betraying the organization.

"Alright, stop arguing. The leader ordered us to chase after him."

Silver Knife interrupted the conversation. His face was cold as he led the Owl Squad into the car.

"Wait, our test subject team will go with us." No. 1 yelled as he led his team members onto the other two vehicles. He had always thought that he was the perfect test subject and was extremely disdainful of Han Xiao, who had a code name before him. However, Han Xiao's battle record had inevitably caused him to fall into a state of self-denial. Therefore, he felt very frustrated. No. 1 felt that only by defeating Han Xiao could he prove his value to the organization.

From the beginning to the end, the Owl Squad did not pay any attention to the surviving guards. Their indifferent attitude showed that they also thought that they could not stop Han Xiao. They were a bunch of trash.

The guards were indignant.

"When they really meet Zero, they will know what they are facing."

This group of guards actually hoped that Zero would succeed in escaping. If even the Owl Squad failed, then wouldn't their mistake seem excusable?

…

Night fell. Through the gaps in the forest, Han Xiao could see the outlines of several asteroids in the sky, emitting blue Radiance. The 'moons' of different shapes were light and mysterious. The galaxy was bright and beautiful.

Every planet in Galaxy had a different environment and style. In Han Xiao's previous life, there were professional casual players who liked interstellar travel. They took pictures of the beautiful scenery of different planets and made them into albums, which were sold out on the official forums.

At this time, the moonlight could not penetrate the forest, so Han Xiao's vision was very unclear.

Han Xiao drove carefully, afraid that he would hit a tree. The night was not good for him. The sound of the engine would expose his position, and he could not drive too fast in the dark.

"Driving at night is not good. I'll just walk."

Han Xiao decided to abandon the car. He stopped the car, pulled out the key, and turned off the engine.

Without the sound of the engine, the silence of the forest instantly surrounded him. The shadows of the trees under the moonlight were like ghostly hands. The atmosphere was eerie.

You have received 5 Military Compressed Biscuits and 3 Mineral Water.

There were a few bottles of water and Military Compressed Biscuits in the trunk of the car. Han Xiao put them all in his bag and walked into the forest alone. The car left a rut on the dirt road in the forest. There was no way for him to erase the tracks, so he could only get out of the car and run in another direction.

Without the car, the darkness of the night instantly became his protective color.

His body was very tired, and he did not have much stamina left. However, Han Xiao did not dare rest. He was not completely out of danger yet.

Vroom! Vroom!

After walking for a while, he heard the roar of a car behind him. He hurriedly hid behind a tree and peeked his head out to look. He saw six headlights flickering in the forest and driving in three different directions.

"Three cars of enemies!" Han Xiao pursed his lips. He had abandoned the car and run, causing the enemies to lose their trail and have to split up to chase after him.

Han Xiao sneakily moved in another direction.

Suddenly, a gunshot broke the silence of the night!

Han Xiaoxin was alerted and fell to the ground. His shoulder was burning with pain. He turned around and saw a bullet graze his right shoulder. There was a hole in the trunk of a tree more than ten meters away.

A car stopped more than three hundred meters away. The entire Owl Third Squad got out of the car. They were all wearing black goggles. The one who fired the shot was the captain, Silver Knife. He was holding a sniper rifle in his hand.

"Six laser eyes?!" Han Xiao was shocked by their outfits. "It's night vision goggles!"

Han Xiao cursed his bad luck and quickly hid behind a tree.

You have been grazed by an SWP sniper rifle on your right shoulder! You have received 18 damage!

Being grazed by a sniper rifle alone was comparable to being hit by a pistol.

You have entered combat mode. Based on your level, you have received detailed information about the enemy!

— —

Night Owl Agent:

Level: 15

Profession: [Special Agent] lv10, [Elite Special Agent] lv5

Attributes: 18 STR, 15 DEX, 25 END, 10 INT, 3 MYS, 8 CHA, 1 LUK

Energy: 0

Energy Rank: 40

HP: 350

Abilities: Well-Trained (Increases base HP by 100), Ignore Pain (Combat effectiveness does not decrease due to injury)

Skills: Lv 4 Basic Combat, Lv 5 Basic Shooting, Lv 2 Precision Shooting, Lv 1 Sniper (Team Leader Configuration)

Equipment:

[SWP Sniper Rifle (Team Leader's Equipment): Grade: Grey, Large Caliber Sniper Rifle, Attack 70 – 88, Fire Rate 0.5/s, Magazine Capacity 5, Damage Level 30, Requirements: Lvl 1 [Sniper]

Thermal Vision Night Vision Goggles: Grade: Gray, Essential for Night Battles

Type 73 WASP Pistol: Grade: Gray, Small Caliber Portable Firearm, Attack: 28 ~ 35, Fire Rate: 1.1/s, Magazine Capacity: 10 Damage: 13

Type G Fragment Grenade (x3): Deals 50-80 damage in a 20-meter radius. Has a chance to deal multiple damage. Energy Rank 45

Kayla Light Bulletproof Vest: Grade: Gray, Ranged Defense 10-12, Durability 50

Alloy Dagger: Grade: Gray, Attack 8-12, Length 0.28m

— —

These six Owl Agents were all elite enemies. Although their levels were lower than his, they were all Tier 2 fighters who specialized in combat. Their attributes were very high, and they were fully armed.
